pages.text: “Like blue stars swaying gently in the wind, slightly bitter yet soothing, resilient and serene.”$(br2)Cornflower Tea is a slightly bitter herbal drink made from dried cornflower petals. With its clear color and subtle fragrance, drinking it enhances a traveler’s resistance, providing increased durability in battles or dangerous environments.

$(br2)$(br)Cornflower Tea is simple to make—$(br)blend dried cornflower petals with sugar to craft this drink of resilience.$(br)It is best consumed before facing formidable foes or embarking on perilous journeys to boost defense.

Upon drinking Cornflower Tea, travelers will receive a temporary resistance boost, allowing them to withstand external damage more effectively.$(br)This tea symbolizes resilience and is ideal for combat and exploration.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
